definitions.explanation: A time duration of five minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{徒歩|とほ}→徒歩：03031_toho⟧{五分|ごふん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's five minutes on foot from the station.

examples.japanese: あと{五分|ごふん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる。
examples.english: It will be done in five more minutes.

examples.japanese: {五分|ごふん}{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集合|しゅうごう}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{五分|ごふん} means "five minutes." It is one of the most commonly used time units in daily life.

PRONUNCIATION:
When counting minutes, {分|ふん} is read as ごふん (not ごぶん). The reading {五分|ごぶ} exists but means "half" or "fifty-fifty" — as in {五分五分|ごぶごぶ} (even odds).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {五分|ごふん}{前|まえ}: five minutes before
- {五分|ごふん}{後|ご}: five minutes later
- {徒歩|とほ}{五分|ごふん}: five minutes on foot
- あと{五分|ごふん}: five more minutes
- {五分|ごふん}{遅刻|ちこく}: five minutes late

USAGE:
{徒歩|とほ}{五分|ごふん} is extremely common in real estate listings and station descriptions to indicate walking distance.
